title: Luis is not well
text: Luis no está bien. Le duele la cabeza. Luis necesita una farmacia. La farmacia está cerca.
native_translation: Luis is not well. His head hurts. Luis needs a pharmacy. The pharmacy is nearby.

title: The pharmacy location
text: La farmacia está a la derecha. El hospital está cerca. Marta necesita ayuda.
native_translation: The pharmacy is on the right. The hospital is nearby. Marta needs help.

title: A short health transcript
text: Médica: ¿Tienes fiebre? Luis: Sí, tengo fiebre. Médica: ¿Te duele la cabeza? Luis: No.
native_translation: Doctor: Do you have a fever? Luis: Yes, I have a fever. Doctor: Does your head hurt? Luis: No.

title: Help scenario
text: Elena está en la estación. No está bien. Dice: Necesito un médico. Pablo dice: El hospital está allí.
native_translation: Elena is at the station. She is not well. She says: I need a doctor. Pablo says: The hospital is there.

title: Travel and help
text: Ana va en metro al centro. Está mal. Pregunta: ¿Dónde está la farmacia? La farmacia está cerca del hotel.
native_translation: Ana goes by metro to the center. She feels bad. She asks: Where is the pharmacy? The pharmacy is near the hotel.

title: Final A0 profile
text: Marta vive en Lima. Su hermana se llama Ana. Ana está enferma. Le duele el estómago. Marta necesita ayuda y agua.
native_translation: Marta lives in Lima. Her sister is named Ana. Ana is sick. Her stomach hurts. Marta needs help and water.
